name: Mind Scan
effectText: While you have a "Toon" card in your field or GY, your opponent must keep their hand revealed, also you can look at their Set cards at any time. If you have a Toon monster and a "Toon" Spell in your field and/or GY: You can declare 1 card name (you cannot declare a name whose effect has been activated in a current Chain); until the end of this turn while this card is face-up, negate the activated effects of cards with that original name. You can only use this effect of "Mind Scan" once per turn.
